text:
elaine: Quick sync — post-launch backlog triage. We need a shortlist for the next 2 sprints: 1) critical bugs to fix, 2) small delightful UX tweaks to ship if capacity allows. Pinged @mike @sam for infra/customer signal.

mike: +1. Can we use the recent crash + embed latency regression as hard blockers? They showed up in SLOs.

sam: I agree on crash. For latency regression, is it isolated to a model variant or universal?

elaine: Looks like majority on v1.3.3 (quantized) under high concurrency. Traces show KV cache misses. Raising as P0.

carol: Filing a repro issue now: https://redwood-internal/issue/PRJ-4821. Added logs and perf trace.

ryan: From PM/UX: we have 3 customer asks that drove launch delight: inline suggestions, stoplight feedback, and faster embed creation. Inline suggestions got most thumbs from beta.

elaine: Proposed split: Sprint A (1 week): crash fix + rollback plan + canary for v1.3.3. Sprint B (2 weeks): latency mitigation (batched KV cache warmup) + one small UX delight (inline suggestions MVP). If sprint A finishes early, pick up embed perf micro-optimizations.

mike: Ops notes: rollback fast path exists but we need DB migration compatibility check. Ops can pair for canary deploys.

sam: Technical ask: for KV cache warmup I can ship a lazy prefetch that primes top 100 prefixes. Low-risk. Could be toggled by flag.

elaine: Nice — flag toggles make rollout safe. Add to Sprint B as opt-in.

carol: Customer-impact scoring suggestion: 3 axes (severity, #customers, regression delta). Quick rubric: severity P0/P1, customers 10+/1-, delta >10% tokens latency.

elaine: Can we add that rubric to the triage doc? 

sam: I'll drop a snippet in the triage doc and open PR.

mike: For prioritization, propose we reserve 50% of capacity for reliability fixes until the crash is closed across canary. Remaining 50% for one delight.

ryan: Product + sales input: customers who reported the crash are on Dedicated and are high-touch. Recommend prioritizing crash and latency. They also want inline suggestions but say it's ok to wait 2 sprints if reliability improves.

elaine: Decision: Immediate P0 on crash + rollback. Sprint A capacity allocation: 70% reliability, 30% unblockers. Sprint B: 60% reliability (latency), 40% delight (inline MVP).

carol: I'll tag engineers and update issue statuses.

ops-bot: deploy: canary started for v1.3.2 -> v1.3.3 (10% traffic) — monitor p99.

mike: Action items: sam -> prefetch prototype (est 2d), carol -> repro + logs cleaned up, ops -> full canary watch until EOD, elaine -> coordinate customer comms.

elaine: Follow-up async check-in Thu 11:00 PT. If crash not resolved by EOD tomorrow we trigger rollback plan. :warning:

ryan: +1 on timeline. I'll draft comms to affected customers after canary stabilization.

sam: Noted. Starting work now, will ping progress in thread.

carol: Repro issue updated with a lean test script and perf snapshots.

elaine: Thanks team. Keeping this thread as the single source for triage updates — short status pings only please. :thumbsup:
